forEveryTeam.p2: Whether you're rewarding top performers, onboarding new employees or bringing remote teams together, we'll create an itinerary around your goals, budget and schedule.

beyondCourt.title: Create Shared Experiences
beyondCourt.subtitle: The best team moments often happen away from the court. Choose from a range of experiences designed to bring people together and create lasting memories.

categories.title: Food & Drink
categories.desc: Interactive cooking classes, tapas tours, wine tastings, private group dinners, and vineyard experiences.

categories.title: Team Adventures
categories.desc: Private boat trips, kayaking, beach games, hiking, golf, and outdoor challenges.

categories.title: Culture & Entertainment
categories.desc: Flamenco experiences, La Liga matchdays, guided city tours, local festivals, and authentic Spanish experiences.

day1Items: AM: Arrival, private transfer to your accommodation, check in and relax.
17:00 – 19:00: Welcome Padel Session – meet the coaches, get to know the group, and enjoy a relaxed coaching session with friendly match play.
19:30: Welcome dinner and drinks to kick off the trip.
day2Items: 10:00 – 12:00: Group padel coaching, team challenges, and friendly match play.
Afternoon: Shared team experience, such as a private boat trip or vineyard tour.
Evening: Dinner at a handpicked local restaurant.
day3Items: 10:00 – 12:00: Friendly team tournament or Americano competition.
Afternoon: Explore the city or enjoy some free time together.
Evening: Interactive cooking class or guided tapas tour.
day4Items: 10:00 – 11:30: Final social matches, prize presentation, and team photo.
12:00: Farewell lunch before your private transfer to the airport.
schedule.footerTitle: Remember: Every Vibra itinerary is fully personalised and designed around your team's goals, interests, and schedule.
